# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c39 P19](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0019), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette has plump hands.

_Sources: [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020)_

## Personality

Odette is a pragmatic, relaxed, and agreeable person without grand ambitions. Unlike some of her companions, she is content simply to meet basic expectations, such as keeping order in her classroom and satisfying her employers, rather than aspiring to be an inspirational figure.

_Sources: [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008)_

## Traits

- Pragmatic  <sub>[v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008)</sub>
- Easygoing  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## Abilities

- Great culinary skills  <sub>[v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027)</sub>
- Teaching  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- Merit her teaching pay, satisfy the school board, and be listed on the Inspector's honor roll  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley as part of a close group of four friends that included Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and Opal Pettigrew. She attended Regent's class alongside her peers to prepare for teaching credentials. Upon finishing her preparation, she took a teaching position in Stonebridge. She later stepped in to help her bashful brother Barney propose marriage to Nell, though Nell declined. After returning from the West, Odette became engaged to Mr. Inglis, a wealthy mining businessman from Winnipeg forty years her senior. At the end of May, she married Mr. Inglis in a grand wedding before embarking on a European honeymoon and settling into a mansion in Winnipeg.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c8 P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001), [v3 c8 P8](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0008), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c39 P19](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0019), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P27](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0027), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035)_
